messages:
harper_marketing: Quick sync — launch day checklist for tomorrow's rollout. Need: final 2-line changelog (marketing phrasing), prod docs permalink, benchmark vignette link, webinar RSVP copy, and HubSpot routing + webhook. Who's on what?
elaine_pm: scope is only batching + streaming reliability. i'll post the two short bullets. keeping it conservative.
tyler_eng: canary set for 09:30 PT, 12m canary + 30m observability. marketing hold public posts until 10:15 PT. we'll post status here.
sophia_docs: packing the docs bundle (migration notes, API diff, examples). will publish prod permalink after deploy. staging preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/2-1-preview
priya_sdr: routing ask: enterprise -> SDR-East, SMB trials -> nurture. also want demo-signup webhook to #sales-live. need the HubSpot tag name.
harper_marketing: tag: `launch-fall-2-1`. changelog draft (marketing-friendly):
- ~15% lower per-token cost for typical embedding-heavy workloads
- streaming reliability fixes that reduce reconnects in long chats
impact sentence idea: "Lower unit costs and steadier streaming help teams scale inference with fewer surprises."
elaine_pm: wording fine; add "typical workloads" qualifier to the first bullet. no hardware specifics public.
tyler_eng: confirmed — 15% is for our common embedding profile; include qualifier. monitoring rule: if p99 > baseline +20% or error rate spikes, we'll halt here and rollback.
sophia_docs: demo assets ready (slides + tiny notebook). staging drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/2-1-demo. adding a one-line curl snippet for the RSVP and confirmation email: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
ryan_ops: webhook endpoint will be enabled post-success: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-fall-2-1. i'll attach a sample payload to the success event.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 09:30 PT. Pushing updates to #release-war-room.
harper_marketing: marketing preference: wait 30m after a green canary before social + email, so schedule public for 10:15 PT.
tyler_eng: agreed. fallback: if we see p99 or errors spike, pause and post rollback intent here. :warning:
priya_sdr: will test HubSpot workflow once you paste the webhook + tag. also will make sure demo signups create `lead:launch-fall-2-1` property.
elaine_pm: changelog final copy for marketing assets: "15% typical token cost reduction for embedding workloads; improved streaming reliability for long conversations." Short impact: "Lower costs and steadier streaming help you scale user-facing inference."
sophia_docs: prod docs permalink now live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide — includes migration snippet and quickstart. benchmark vignette (anonymized): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/2-1-benchmarks
ryan_ops: enabling webhook on success. will post sample payload on this thread when deploy-bot reports success.
deploy-bot: Canary succeeded at 09:42 PT. Observability hold until 10:12 PT. Event payload sample: { "event":"release", "version":"2.1", "status":"canary-success" }
harper_marketing: scheduling social + email for 10:15 PT. confirmation email needs: docs permalink, slides link, demo notebook, 1-line changelog, and webinar RSVP link. will draft now and drop for a quick PR.
priya_sdr: HubSpot workflow updated and webhook tested. routing live. demo signup posts to #sales-live.
tyler_eng: monitoring green so far. stand by for the hold to finish.
harper_marketing: thanks all — posting copy in 10 for rapid PR. holding here for any rollback signals. :rocket:
